exDef.label: Unsafe to deliver
exDef.desc: Animal, hazard or threat at the address.

history.text: Leave the gate shut. Tap the horn or ring from outside and wait for the owner to secure the dog.

exDef.label: Unsafe to deliver
exDef.desc: Animal, hazard or threat at the address.

history.text: Stop. Stand still and calm, arms in, with the package between you and the dog.
Avoid eye contact, speak calmly, and back away slowly toward the truck, keeping the dog in view.
Don't go back. Record an "unsafe to deliver" exception so the dog is on file for this address.
Stop at the bottom of the steps and ask him to take Pepper inside, or hold her collar, before you come up.
She was scared, and a frightened dog can bite when it feels cornered.

items.label: Handled a loose dog behind a gate
items.feedback: Never let yourself into a yard with a loose dog, however friendly it looks. Get the owner to secure it first.

items.label: Climbed down from the cab with three points of contact
items.lesson: Use three points of contact getting in and out of the truck. Jumping down is one of the most common ways couriers get hurt.

items.label: Climbed back into the cab safely
items.lesson: Grab handle, one step at a time, and never jump up while carrying anything.

scope: Existing-id registration, accessibility and a suspended workday are setup fixtures. Observational wrappers record completed original conversations and pre-evaluation stop facts without changing arguments or return values. Real keys control all walking, aiming, parcels, safety actions, replies, photos, signing and results. No position, timer, node, hazard, signature-completion, score or verdict fixture. Independent original 2D callbacks replay observed choices and evaluate observed stop facts. Bounds checks do not certify Tamil glyph coverage or Intel FPS.
